title: [epic] CAR file export — portable group archive format
description:
Why: IPFS Content Addressable aRchive (CAR) files are the standard portable format for exporting IPFS DAG content. Exporting a newsgroup's article history as a CAR file gives operators a verifiable, self-contained archive that can be imported into any IPFS node, stored offline, or handed to an archival service. Every block in the CAR is content-addressed so integrity is provable.

What:
- Add a transit admin API endpoint: GET /admin/export/car?group=<name>[&since=<cid>]
- The export traverses the group's Merkle-CRDT log from the tip, collects all article root CIDs and their sub-blocks (header, body), and serialises them as a CARv1 or CARv2 file.
- Streaming response — do not buffer the entire archive in memory.
- Optional since= parameter to export only entries added after a known CID (incremental export).
- CARv2 index for fast random access by CID.
- Rust crate: iroh-car or car (from ipld ecosystem) for CAR serialisation.
